description: The default list is created once; every call without `tags` appends to the same list.
diff:
diff --git a/app/catalog.py b/app/catalog.py
--- a/app/catalog.py
+++ b/app/catalog.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
-def make_item(name):
-    return {"name": name, "tags": []}
+def make_item(name, tags=[]):
+    tags.append("new")
+    return {"name": name, "tags": tags}
